summary: Iteration 12 — FLUJOMATCH v2. Backend: 12/12 pytest PASS covering (a) POST /like proposals writing + all 4 system-message variants (same-activity 'Están de acuerdo', different 'A X le tinca … a Y le tinca … ¿Cuál va primero?', only-one 'A X le tinca … ¿Te sumas?', no-plan '¡Se dio el match!'), (b) /matches returns proposals resolved with plan_status/confirmed_activity/confirmed_at, (c) GET /likes-received filters (matched, passed, blocked, banned) and payload shape (id/profile/mode/proposed_activity/seen/created_at) with clean public profile (no email/coords/password_hash), (d) POST /likes-received/seen + /notifications/counts.unseen_likes goes to 0, (e) total = new_matches + unread_messages + unseen_likes, (f) nudge job fires exactly once after 48h with both-sides messages and sets nudge_sent=True; second call is idempotent; skipped when plan_status='confirmed', (g) /admin/users regression: no location.coords leak. Frontend: E2E on demo1 verified: two tabs (tab-chats/tab-likes), unseen badge shows 1 → cleared after opening Les tincas, 3 like cards rendered with 'contigo' text + like-armar-{id}/like-pasar-{id} + linkable avatar/alias, activity picker modal opens with 16 pick-act-* buttons pre-selected on sender's proposal, submit-armar-plan creates match and navigates to /app/chats/{match_id} with '¡Hay match! 💛' toast, ChatDetail shows plan-status-bar chip 'Café y conversación' + '¿Cuál va primero?' text and one msg-system pill '¡Están de acuerdo! ☕ Café y conversación. Solo falta el cuándo 😊' with gradient border. BottomNav chats-badge counts include unseen_likes (verified via code inspection: line 55 of BottomNav.jsx sums new_matches + unread_messages + unseen_likes).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1073 _maybe_send_plan_nudges runs synchronously on every /matches call. Fine at current traffic; if load grows, move to a scheduled job to avoid extra reads-per-request per idle match.
server.py:1191 result.sort with reverse=False is a no-op (keys are 0/1 tuples) — proposals-first ordering works, but the reverse=False flag is superfluous. Cosmetic.

server.py:940 same-activity comparison uses `my_act['id'] == their_act['id']` — correct. But if either activity_id refers to a deleted/missing activity, acts_by_id lookup returns None and cases (a/b/c) silently collapse to (d) 'no_proposal' path. Not a bug (defensive), but consider a warn-log if a proposal activity_id has no matching activity.
Chats.jsx L28-31 openLikesTab still switches tab even if POST /likes-received/seen fails (caught, ignored). Correct UX (don't punish the user for a transient network glitch).

ChatDetail.jsx L149-192 sticky bar is not actually sticky (position not set to sticky). The status bar is inline under the header — works for the current single-scroll layout but the review-request word 'sticky' is aspirational, not literal. Not blocking.

server.py:967 legacy `proposed_activity` field still written on new match docs alongside proposals — kept for backwards compat with older clients. Consider removing after full rollout to reduce doc bloat.

server.py migration L1913 back-fills `proposals: {user: aid, other: aid}` for legacy matches by cloning the single `proposed_activity` id to BOTH sides. This is a best-effort inference and may over-represent 'same activity' cases for legacy matches — acceptable, mentioned in code comment.
